data.name: Offworlder
data.detailed_description:
Crash-land into the unknown. Will you conquer it - or will it conquer you?

You are an Offworlder: a survivor of galactic war hurled onto a vast, unforgiving alien world. This mysterious planet pulses with danger - toxic storms rage across barren wastelands, ferocious predators stalk the shadows, and ancient ruins whisper of a hidden power.

Your only hope of survival? Fight, craft, and adapt to unravel the planet's secrets before the exotic wilderness claims you.

Offworlder blends intense survival mechanics with deep RPG progression, turn-based combat, and expansive crafting in a richly detailed sci-fi universe.

Key Features:

  • Survive on an Alien Frontier: Manage hunger, radiation, oxygen, and extreme weather while exploring the vast biomes - from cracked deserts strewn with colossal bones to lush, bioluminescent jungles.

  • Deep Crafting & Base Building: Scavenge resources from the environment to forge high-tech gear, vehicles, and fortified outposts. Build anything from simple shelters to massive automated facilities.

  • RPG Progression & Skill Mastery: Level up your character with a flexible skill tree. Specialize in skills to suit your playstyle.

  • Tame the Wild: Discover and domesticate alien creatures - train them as mounts, guards, or resource gatherers to aid your survival.

  • Uncover Planetary Mysteries: Delve into hidden ruins, analyze ancient tech, and piece together the story of what happened to those who came before. Your choices shape the narrative and unlock powerful technologies.

  • Dynamic World: Day-night cycles, random events, and evolving ecosystems keep every playthrough fresh and challenging.

Offworlder challenges you to not just survive - but to conquer a planet and claim its secrets as your own.

Do you have what it takes to forge a legacy among the stars?

Per Aspera Ad Astra

data.short_description: Offworlder – a Sci-fi survival-crafting RPG. Crash-land on a deadly alien planet. Conquer harsh biomes teeming with exotic beasts and biomechanical abominations. Master turn-based combat, build fortified bases, and unravel the planets dark secrets in this gripping survival epic.
